originalBrief: Build a fair, not-too-hard Map 1 level. Use only Burger and Soda orderable families; exclude Fried Basket. About 80% of all ingredient queue slots must belong to 2-slot combined groups, and both slots in each combined group must contain the same ingredient. Do not use any other special mechanics.
